service.description: Scheme and host of the current request, without trailing slash, honouring the X-Forwarded-Proto header set by the nginx proxy.
Public content pages of a store: path, title, description, html and markdown url. Built on the page list get#StoreInfo already assembles.

actions.script: List storePages = (List) (storeInfo.pages ?: []) // the home page is the one titled 'home', else the first page: same rule as home.xml // match on the path, not the title: under a language the titles are translated Map homePage = storePages.find({ it.path?.toLowerCase()?.startsWith('home') }) ?: storePages.find({ it.title?.toLowerCase()?.startsWith('home') }) ?: storePages[0] homePath = homePage?.path pages = [] for (Object pageObj in storePages) { Map storePage = (Map) pageObj boolean isHome = storePage.path == homePath String sitePath = isHome ? '' : 'content/' + storePage.path // the language is part of the url, not of the page path String siteUrlPath = urlPrefix ? (sitePath ? urlPrefix.substring(1) + '/' + sitePath : urlPrefix.substring(1)) : sitePath pages.add([path: storePage.path, sitePath: siteUrlPath, isHome: isHome, pagePath: pagePathPrefix + storePage.path, title: storePage.title, description: storePage.description, pageType: storePage.pageType, lastModified: storePage.lastModified, url: baseUrl + '/' + siteUrlPath, markdownUrl: baseUrl + '/md/' + siteUrlPath]) }

service.description: Markdown twin of a public page with yaml front matter. sitePath is the html path without the leading slash: '' for the home page, 'content/xxx' for a content page.
